aiTitle: Replace workspace number keys with previous/next toggles

content.thinking: I'm seeing a conflict here—SUPER+P and SUPER+semicolon are already mapped to focus directions up and down, but the user wants to repurpose them for workspace navigation instead. I need to flag this binding conflict and clarify what the user actually wants, since they're asking to replace the number-based workspace switching with previous/next workspace toggles.

content.text: SUPER+P and SUPER+; are already bound (keybinds.lua:80-81) to window-focus up/down. Overwriting them removes that functionality.

questions.question: SUPER+P and SUPER+; currently move window focus up/down (keybinds.lua:80-81). How should I handle this?

options.label: Overwrite them
